content: For the Find a Doc API, I recommend using Redis with a sliding expiration. Add IDistributedCache via the Redis provider. Cache the search results with a key based on the query parameters hash. Set a 5-minute sliding expiration so popular searches stay warm. For the provider detail pages, use a longer 30-minute absolute expiration since that data changes less frequently. Make sure to invalidate the cache when provider data updates come through from Epic.
